title: Chuyên đề Kinh doanh quốc tế – E

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop proficiency in English language skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing) in the context of international business.
Gain comprehensive understanding of international business, including trade and foreign direct investment.
Understand and analyze the impact of cultural, economic, political, and legal environments on international business.
Understand and apply principles of organizational structure and management in international business.
Develop critical thinking and analytical skills to solve practical problems in international business.
Understand ethical and social responsibilities in international business.

prerequisite_courses: Tiếng Anh – Kỹ năng Nghe, Nói 3
Tiếng Anh – Kỹ năng Đọc, Viết 3
Thực hành tổng hợp - Tiếng Anh kinh tế và kinh doanh 2
